_comment: Golden baseline for tests/eval_reconstruct.py. Regenerate with `python tests/eval_reconstruct.py --update-baseline` after an INTENTIONAL change to the reconstruct/meshpipe geometry path. The synthetic input is a known box rendered from 12 turntable views and fused via the deterministic numpy point-merge + convex-hull path (prefer_tsdf=False), so these numbers do not depend on Open3D/PyMeshLab being installed.

tolerances._comment: Counts are bounded by a wide [min, max] band, NOT a tight relative tolerance: fuse() tries an alpha-shape before falling back to convex_hull, so the exact vertex/face count is a Qhull/trimesh-version artifact that can vary across environments. The hard regression gates are dimensional accuracy (max_dim_rel_error_abs) and the structural invariants (watertight, single component, bbox dims within extents_abs_mm) -- those hold for any faithful reconstruction of the box.
